title: FIG. 06 · Accretion rings
summary: A's calm state-change section, with the mark staircase replaced by one precise C-style drawing: the first three quarters each draw a ring that collapses back to zero, the system is installed at Q4 as the one red ring, and every later quarter accretes a ring that stays, so Δ counts what was carried forward.

reference.site: Round 1 · A + C (statechange A 'The mark, compounding', drawn with statechange C's 'Datum drawing sheet' precision)
reference.borrowed: From A (Goldsand's 'Simulate your savings' plate): one flat FIG. plate holding an accumulating figure at left and one huge reading at right, a control that re-runs the simulation, and a state sentence anchored bottom-right. From C (Wild's 'Explore. Generate. Refine. Scale.' field): one axis read left to right as a process, the datum at Q4 where the system is installed (the one red element), Δ measured as a dimension, coded callouts and a small title block.
reference.kelwin: The figure is now the ORBIT primitive, not the logo. Rings sit on one centre on a modular step (+8px a quarter: 40 · 68 · 104 · 148 · 200), so each deposit is thicker than the last. One horizontal axis makes the reading path, and it is deliberately one-sided so it never reads as a crosshair: on the left, callout 01 'Q1–Q3 reset to zero' rides a dashed line into the centre (zero, nothing kept); on the right, a solid radius line carries Q4–Q8, each label set ON its own ring in the contour-map manner (the ring and line are knocked out behind it), then dashed construction carries on to Δ5 and 'Quarters compounding'. A vertical dimension tangent to the outer ring measures 'Carried forward', and callout 02 'Installed at Q4' leaves the red ring on a radial leader. The caption band holds a four-cell title block (FIG. 06 · Accretion · System/Entropy · Specimen) beside the Entropy | System control. Every piece is a kit-ac component (.ac-head, .ac-plate, .ac-field, .ac-capband, .ac-tblock, .ac-seg, .ac-num, .ac-callout__code/__t, .ac-s-*, .ac-t-knock, .ac-node).

motion: entrance: the kit runs the head (hairline draws, label, 'Stop resetting.' rises, the light 'Start compounding.' follows 200ms later, red rule, lede). The FIG. 06 plate rises 12px at 420ms and opens on Entropy (Δ 0). Callout 01 and its dashed line arrive first (640ms), so the figure starts at 01, then the centre and the dashed construction line.

the orchestrated moment: Q1, Q2 and Q3 each draw a ring counter-clockwise from the axis (≈400ms) and then collapse into the centre (≈300ms), and the centre node latches. Callout 01 counts 'Q1' → 'Q1–Q2' → 'Q1–Q3'. At 2.7s the control flips to System: the red Q4 ring draws and stays (520ms), Q5–Q8 accrete outward (600ms each, 160ms stagger), each Q label lands on its ring as it closes, and the solid radius line grows out over the dashed one. Δ counts 1 → 5 as each ring closes, the state sentence swaps (the old one leaves before the new one arrives, never overlapping) and the 'Carried forward' dimension draws last. Everything has landed by about 4.8s.
ambient: in System one node rides the outer ring (18s a lap), the section's only loop; it passes behind the Q8 label. In Entropy the rider is hidden and one quarter resets every 8s instead.

interaction: Entropy | System are real buttons with aria-pressed and replay the argument in either direction. Entropy retracts the rings outer-first (the red ring last) and the solid radius line, so only dashed construction remains, Δ falls to 0 and a quarter resets. System re-runs the accretion.

on the live site: the sequence plays once when the plate is 40% visible (IntersectionObserver, no pin), and the first click stops the demo for good. Reduced motion renders the System drawing synchronously, with the rider resting at 110°, and starts no timers or loops.
notes: Illustrative quarters, labelled SPECIMEN in the title block. One red only: the Q4 ring (plus the family label square and 48×2 rule); the section has no primary button. C quotas: 1 drawing, 2 callouts, 1 dimension, 1 title block (4 cells), 16 annotation words, no registration marks (the drawing sits in A's plate), mono only for one-line codes and labels at 11–12px. Δ is the kit's big numeral at 176px (same as evidence), an inline SVG at Mona's cap height with its stroke following --display-weight, because the shipped Mona subset has no Δ; the digit turns off Mona's slashed zero so Δ0 never reads as Ø. Kit note: `.ac-seg > button:hover` (0,2,1) outranks `.ac-seg > [aria-pressed]` (0,2,0), so hovering the pressed segment turns its label white-on-white; this fragment guards it locally and the kit should fix it globally. The plate is 520px (464 field + 56 band), the top of the spec range. The HTML is generated by scratchpad/sc2-gen/gen-statechange-x.mjs (all geometry in one place).
addressed: A and C combined: A's calm head, plate, big Δ reading and Entropy | System control stay. From C comes one precisely drawn figure: a labelled radius line, a 'Carried forward' dimension, two numbered callouts and a small title block. There's no cell grid, spec table or mono paragraph.
The logo-symbol staircase is gone. The quarters are now rings drawn around one centre, with no nested corners, steps or corner square anywhere in the section.

The figure tells the story in motion. Q1–Q3 each draw a ring that collapses back to zero. At Q4 the system is installed (the one red ring), then Q5–Q8 build outward and stay while Δ counts from 0 to 5.
It reads in one direction: 01 on the left runs along a single line into the centre, then out through Q4–Q8 to Δ5. Each quarter label sits on its own ring, so it is always clear which ring is which.
The control is real. Entropy pulls the rings back and leaves only a dashed line, because nothing was kept. System builds them again.
